newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber edges down in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber edges down in slow trading.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices edged down in slow late trading on Thursday on weak demand, dealers said.
"Some sellers in Palembang have started lowering their offer prices after several days of very slow demand," one dealer in Jakarta said.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for October/November deliveries edged down 0.25 cents/lb to 56.00-56.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and to 55.75-56.25 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang, and to 55.25-55.75 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
Another dealer said SIR20 was last traded at 56.25 cents/lb November deliveries fob Palembang late on Wednesday.
Dealers, however, said the deal did not reflect the general market as the offtakes were in very small quantity.
They said demand was likely to remain weak on Friday despite tight supply due to rains.
High amoniac grade latex with 60 percent dry rubber content was last traded at 2,230 rupiah/kg against the previous 2,250 rupiah in Bandung and Tangerang, dealers said.
